summary.text: Frankie Delapas is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 74, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where the Republican nominee is incumbent Guy Ward.
Delapas also ran for the seat in 2024, losing the general election to incumbent Mike DeVault.
